status.en: 117 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 38% fewer than the week before, most of them in Delhi, Mumbai and Uttar Pradesh.
status.nb: 117 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 38 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Delhi, Mumbai og Uttar Pradesh.

summary.en: Security officials met in Jammu to review anti-infiltration measures while Manipur security forces buried seven Kuki civilians killed by militants after two months and relocated the BSF Raising Day parade to Delhi over security concerns. China and India held fresh border talks as both sides increased military readiness before winter. A bear attack injured five people in Udhampur and a leopard injured a seven-year-old boy in Kupwara shortly after a fatal attack in the same district. The UCDP recorded 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsoffiserer møttes i Jammu for å gjennomgå anti-inntrengings-tiltak mens sikkerhetsstyrkene i Manipur begravde syv Kuki-sivile drept av militante etter to måneder, og flyttet BSF-s “Raising Day”-paraden til Delhi av sikkerhetsgrunner. Kina og India holdt nye grenseforhandlinger mens begge sider økte militær beredskap før vinteren. Et bjørnangrep så fem personer bli skadet i Udhampur, og en leopard så en syv år gammel gutt bli skadet i Kupwara kort tid etter et dødelig angrep i samme distrikt. UCDP registrerte 437 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
